description: Source code for a web scraper class 'RutgerBakt' that extracts recipe information from 'rutgerbakt.nl'. It defines methods to get author, title, category, yields, ingredient groups, instructions, and description, utilizing HTML parsing and utility functions.

classes.name: RutgerBakt
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from rutgerbakt.nl, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'rutgerbakt.nl' for the target website.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author name 'Rutger van den Broek'.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the recipe title from the schema.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Finds and returns the recipe category from the page footer links.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns None as yields are inconsistent.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients using the imported 'group_ingredients' utility.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions by locating the relevant heading and parsing subsequent elements.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the first paragraph text as the recipe description.
